title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Boston College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman: Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Judith F. Judson and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 04-GC-29)
